title: Why every Episode starts from a copy
caption: One spine: Episode, Section, Slide.
prose: Copy this folder, then replace the words. A <ref>reference Episode</ref> keeps every Episode the same shape.

reference-episode.description: The template exists so every Episode is built the same way. Point at the prose when you say so.

spine.description: An Episode holds Sections, a Section holds Slides. Press the button to walk down the spine.

one-breath.title: The template in one breath
one-breath.script: A reference Episode shows the shape once, so the next Episode copies a working example instead of inventing one.

the-spine.title: The spine
the-spine.script: Walk down the three levels: the Episode, its Sections, and the Slides inside each.
the-spine.bridge: Next, a Slide that is only a picture.
